flow:
%% suite "Recorded flow"
flowchart TD
  n0(("http://localhost:3000/demo.html"))
  n1["/demo.html#/dashboard"]
  n2["/demo.html#/settings"]

  n0 -->|fill 'Email' : label = 'qa@example.com'; fill 'Password' : label = $QA_PASS; click 'Sign in' : button| n1

name: Search, add Widget Pro, open the cart
flow:
%% suite "Shop"
testcase TD
  n0(("http://localhost:3000/shop.html"))
  n1{{"2 results"}}
  n2["/shop.html#/cart"]
  n3{{"Widget Pro × 1"}}

  n0 -->|fill 'Search' : textbox = 'widget'; click 'Search' : button| n1
  n1 -->|click 'Add Widget Pro' : button; click 'Cart' : link| n2
  n2 --> n3
